title: Finalize the integrated result and deliver an evidence-audited report
goal: Deliver a report that explains the checked result, unmet criteria, assumptions and uncertainty, with independent final acceptance on the actual integrated snapshot.
scope: Implement CriteriaProjection+JournalDigest ContextComposer: assignment targets, criterion text, permitted visible checks, relevant decision/evidence refs and bounded history, with attributable profile/instructions. Use actual projection boundaries; hidden content filtering is extended in W2-0001.

Finalize only when no invocation, including revoked/disconnected work, can still change the aggregate workspace; otherwise record Blocked(effects_uncertain) without snapshot/merge/final acceptance. Rerun checks on the stable target and admit FinalReviewer outside the producer union; absence yields Blocked(final_review_pending). A user stop skips further model-assisted finalization.

Implement Report/Claim and replaceable NarrativeComposer: bounded admitted Narrator charged to Reporting, plus DeterministicReport alternative/fallback from journal facts. EvidenceClassRules audits applicable Status/Executed/Browser/Causal/Scope/Recommendation support; allow at most one paid correction within reserve and continuation authority, then narrow unsupported claims to uncertainty.

Deliver an audited report also for Blocked/Cancelled outcomes. After user stop, unavailable/failed Narrator, insufficient defensible funds or absent continuation authority, use DeterministicReport without another model call. Settle or conservatively retain narration/correction cost before ReportDelivered; include actual expenses/unknowns, unmet criteria and assumptions without another narration call. Fallback is an explanation, not an unfinished task artifact.
acceptance: Finalization rechecks the actual stable aggregate with an independent FinalReviewer. An invocation that may still change that aggregate blocks finalization; unrelated isolated work does not fabricate a global stop. Stale candidate evidence or review cannot justify current aggregate acceptance.

ClaimAuditor applies the same applicability boundary as A7/A8, rejects stale or mismatched causal support, and retains unmet criteria/assumptions. Unsupported narration receives at most one authorized funded correction; otherwise an audited deterministic report contains uncertainty, not invented acceptance or completed artifacts.

A run selects admitted Narrator or DeterministicReport through the same NarrativeComposer consumer, with recoverable PolicyRef values. User stop launches zero new model calls; failed/unaffordable narration still delivers facts and accounted expenses. ContextComposer/ClaimAuditor/ReviewerPolicy also have materially different real-consumer implementations, and learning cannot delay delivery.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.6, 4 (AcceptanceAuthority.finalize), 5.3 (ReviewerPolicy), 5.7 (ContextComposer, NarrativeComposer, ClaimAuditor), A11 and R-5/R-8/R-15. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-domain/src/report.rs, crates/ymp-kernel/src/finalization.rs and crates/ymp-runtime/src/policies/{context,narrative,claim_audit}.rs. Prerequisites provide stable snapshots, producer sets, checks, acceptance and execution. Build finalization/report behavior from these new contracts.

ResourcePolicy.reporting_reserve from W1-0004 supplies protected Budget capacity without a mandatory Constraints/TUI field. Narrator and one correction are bounded Reporting assignments; DeterministicReport is a selectable alternative and the zero-call fallback after stop or unavailable/unfunded narration. Account narration expenses before ReportDelivered.

A11 blocks only work that can still change the aggregate. Apply the same evidence applicability as A7/A8; final review excludes the aggregate producer union. Fallback explains recorded results, unknowns and unmet criteria and never replaces an unfinished task artifact.
